title: Mayer–Vietoris sequence for derived Hom on a two-open cover
statement: Let X be a ringed space covered by open subspaces U and V. For any two objects E and F of its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], there is an exact sequence from global Hom(E,F) to the direct sum of Hom between their restrictions to U and V, then to Hom between their restrictions to the intersection; the second map is the difference of restrictions, and this is the beginning of the Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence with a preceding negative Ext term.
